topic: Can PR cell bandwidth limitations restrict spectrum reuse strategies in high-throughput satellite payload configurations?
response: Yes, PR cell bandwidth limitations can restrict spectrum reuse strategies in high-throughput satellite payload configurations due to inter-cell interference and signal strength degradation at beam borders.
reference_context: The context highlights that multibeam satellite systems employ a four-color spectrum reuse pattern to avoid coverage conflict and improve spectrum efficiency. However, it also notes that signal strength is weaker at the border of each beam compared to its center.
